text: {"reconstruction":4,"feasibility":3,"rationale":"The proposal gets the IMDb → Rotten Tomatoes → mail-compose sequence and the parameters right (the friend is split into email and name, and the email is derived from the friend in the true workflow), but it ends with \"Send the email\" when the true workflow says do not send and click Discard, which would be a harmful error if automated; it also adds cookie-banner steps and leaves the compose-page opening vague."}

data.rationale: The proposal gets the IMDb → Rotten Tomatoes → mail-compose sequence and the parameters right (the friend is split into email and name, and the email is derived from the friend in the true workflow), but it ends with "Send the email" when the true workflow says do not send and click Discard, which would be a harmful error if automated; it also adds cookie-banner steps and leaves the compose-page opening vague.
